messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian public holidays that typically create long‑weekend opportunities in 2023 (i.e., holidays falling on a Friday or Monday, or those that can be observed on the nearest weekday).  

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan) |  |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) |  |
| **March 17** | Wednesday | St. Patrick’s Day (British Columbia) |  |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday |  |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Quebec, Ontario, New Brunswick, PEI) |  |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day |  |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (BC, Yukon) |  |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces except BC, NB, PEI, NL) |  |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day |  |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Canada) |  |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday) |  |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day |  |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day |  |

### Long‑Weekend Highlights (Friday–Monday)

| Weekend | Holiday | Resulting Long Weekend |
|---------|---------|------------------------|
| **Jan 27–28** | Family Day (AB, SK) |  |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (ON, MB, NB, PEI) |  |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday |  |
| **May 21–23** | Victoria Day |  |
| **Jun 15–19** | National Indigenous Peoples Day |  |
| **Aug 5–7** | Civic Holiday |  |
| **Sep 15–18** | Labour Day |  |
| **Oct 6–9** | Thanksgiving |  |
| **Nov 4–7** | Remembrance Day |  |
| **Dec 24–26** | Christmas & Boxing Day |  |

These dates cover the major statutory holidays that give Canadians a chance to enjoy a three‑day break. If you’re building an app, you could use this table as a static reference or pull from a reliable holiday API (e.g., Calendarific, Timezonedb, or a local government source) for dynamic updates.
